Wire a tag_check(sym, node) helper (same two-line/decorator-aware shape as anchor()) called from visit_ClassDef and _func with sym=the entity's OWN symbol (whole-function case), and from visit_Assign/visit_AnnAssign with sym=self.here() (the enclosing entity/module -- matches declare()'s own attribution model, and covers the real corpus's function-local-assignment majority case). Emit one statement per tag: {s: sym, p: 'tag', o: kind, d: {text}}. GREEN: implement, make it pass, attest c2.

why_trail.why: Read handoff, DESIGN_SPEC comment-grammar (line 97-106) and cull-test (line 242) sections, extract.py anchor/anchors_in/span_hash, render.py load_stores/entity_page. Confirmed via read-only f1Brainz PR 733 inspection: all 6 real tags are multi-line paragraphs above Assign statements, 5/6 function-local, 4 Constraint/1 Rejected/1 Rationale, zero slugs. Convention-gap resolution: a tag binds to the CURRENTLY ENCLOSING entity/module symbol (self.here()) -- a tag directly above a def/class binds to that entity's own symbol (whole-function case); a tag above a statement inside a body binds to the enclosing entity, since pages exist per-entity not per-statement.

tags_in() added (mirrors anchors_in's forward-scan, recognizes Rationale:/Rejected:/See: paragraphs with continuation-line joining and back-to-back-tag splitting). tag_check(sym,node) wired at visit_ClassDef/_func (sym=entity's own symbol, whole-function case) and visit_Assign/visit_AnnAssign (sym=self.here(), any scope including function-local -- covers the real corpus's majority shape). 5/5 comment_tags tests green: module-level, whole-function, function-local-assignment, See-reference, multiline-paragraph-join.

render.py intercepts p=='tag' into tags[sym]; tag_lines(key) is one list-comprehension formatting every tag as f'{kind}: {text}' with zero conditional dispatch on kind (verified by an AST-level test walking tag_lines' own source for any Compare mentioning kind -- none found). Wired into entity_page() and module_index(). 10/10 comment_tags green. CULL TEST APPLIED: same section, same order, same format, no branch reads kind anywhere in the render path -> VERDICT: collapse. Assumption:/Constraint: are removed from the shipped grammar (extract.py's TAG_START only recognizes Rationale:/Rejected:/See:); Rationale is the survivor per DESIGN_SPEC's own collapse wording. Rejected:/See: were never collapse candidates -- SY5's finding and the cull test text both scope to Assumption:/Constraint:/Rationale: only, since a rejected alternative and a reference are different KINDS of fact, not another flavor of rationale.

cull-verdict.json written at .agent-work/issue-456/cull-verdict.json: verdict=collapse, collapsed_to=Rationale, shipped_keywords=[Rationale,Rejected,See]. Checkable against code, not merely readable: 5 pinning tests re-derive the claims from extract.TAG_START.pattern (keyword membership) and an independent AST-walk of render.tag_lines' own source (zero Compare nodes mention kind) rather than trusting the file's own prose. Rejected/See explicitly marked candidate_for_collapse=false with the reasoning that the cull test's own text never put them on trial. 15/15 comment_tags green, 8 subtests.

join test test_comment_tags_stale_tag_flags_a_real_body_change_under_a_live_tag added: a fixture function carries both a [slug] anchor and a Rationale: tag in the same comment block; mutating the function's body (BASE*2 -> BASE*3) while leaving both slug and tag text untouched flags the slug in stale-anchor, proving g6's existing span_hash/diff machinery (zero lines touched) now fires against real tag text for the first time. stale_tag selector grew 14 -> 15 passed (12 subtests), 15/15 green. extract.py's stale-anchor code path was not modified. Workflow feedback recorded: handoff's illustration named Constraint:, substituted for Rationale: per the m2/m3 cull verdict.

tests/fixtures/comment_tags_corpus/ added (README.md + corpus.py), precedent overread_corpus/. CommentTagNegativeTests: 2 negative tests (plain '# Note:' comment; retired Assumption:/Constraint: keywords), each paired with the SAME positive-control assertion (scaled()'s Rationale: tag) in the same method. Self-check run three ways, then reverted: (1) widened TAG_START to accept Assumption|Constraint -> retired-keywords negative test AND 2 subtests of CullVerdictArtifactTests went red; (2) widened TAG_START to accept Note -> plain-comment negative test went red; (3) disabled tag_check entirely -> 12 of 18 comment_tags tests went red, including both negative tests via their positive controls. Zero negative tests survived any breakage. All reverted; git diff --quiet confirms extract.py matches its pre-breakage content; 32/32 comment_tags+stale_tag green after revert. Convention-gap resolution restated for the RESULT doc: a tag binds to self.here() (enclosing entity/module), so a whole-function tag lands on the entity's own page and a statement-level tag lands on the SAME enclosing entity's page -- there is no finer page granularity.
